DB_TYPE.description: Database engine: postgres for production, sqlite for local dev

PG_HOSTNAME.description: PostgreSQL server hostname (e.g., postgres-service from Docker Compose).

PG_DATABASE.description: PostgreSQL database name for Keycloak storage (default: keycloak).

PG_USERNAME.description: Username for PostgreSQL database access (default: keycloak).

PG_PASSWORD.description: Password for PostgreSQL user. Required when connecting to production database.

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Initial admin username for master realm (default: admin).

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial admin password set on first startup. Change via Admin UI after setup.

KC_PROXY.description: Proxy configuration: edge=Railway TLS, passthrough/reencrypt options.

KC_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Enable HTTP listener (true/false). Default true in dev mode.

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Public hostname for Keycloak access. Must match Railway domain or custom domain.

PORT.description: Port the service listens on inside the container
